title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Insight AI Labs needs a Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy models for customer analytics and NLP products. You will engineer features with Python, Pandas and SQL, train models with scikit-learn, build deep learning models in PyTorch or TensorFlow, work on NLP and large language models, and ship models as Docker containers on AWS. 2+ years of hands-on machine learning experience and a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics or a related field are required.
